package contract

import "context"

//plystra:resource accounts.access/v1
type Resource interface {
	Register(context.Context, Request) (Result, error)
	Clear(context.Context, Empty) (Empty, error)
}

type Empty struct{}

type Request struct {
	AccountID int64
	SessionID int64
	Email string
	Digest []byte
	Active bool
	Score float64
}

type Result struct {
	AccountID int64
	SessionID int64
	Email string
	Digest []byte
	Active bool
	Score float64
	Note *string
}
